topics.title: Graduate job listings hit a low
topics.summary: UK graduate job vacancies fell nearly in half from last year, with Adzuna recording the lowest July total since it began tracking the data in 2016.
topics.discussionPrompt: If someone fresh out of school joined the studio today, what weird skill would actually make them instantly useful around here?

topics.title: Shein lines up Hong Kong IPO
topics.summary: Fast-fashion company Shein is preparing a Hong Kong listing that could value it near $27 billion, far below earlier private-market estimates.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio had to explain a giant discount shopping empire going public, who would focus on the money and who would ask about the closets?

topics.title: Hidden car handles face recall
topics.summary: Automakers including Tesla, Xiaomi, Xpeng, and Geely are reportedly recalling millions of vehicles in China over flush electronic door handles and emergency-access concerns.
topics.discussionPrompt: What gadget looks sleek in a showroom but would drive everyone in the studio absolutely nuts after one bad day?

topics.title: Ukraine marks independence anniversary
topics.summary: Ukraine marked its 35th independence anniversary as European leaders arrived in Kyiv and officials highlighted continued support for the country.
topics.discussionPrompt: For a big anniversary under pressure, what kind of studio celebration feels respectful without turning stiff or gloomy?
